text.text: Your med spa in one place. Start with Appointments for today's treatments, keep Memberships healthy with credits and renewal dates, and check Inventory for items to reorder. Operational tracking only; clinical charting stays in your clinical system.
A good first visit makes the second one easy to book.
Send the consultation form before the visit.
Review goals and previous treatments with the client.
Have consent forms signed before any treatment.
Confirm the person and the treatment on the appointment.
Give the aftercare sheet and write the date of the next visit on it.
Mark the appointment Completed so spend and credits update.
Press Start membership on the client.
Choose the plan, monthly fee and credits included.
Check Credits left and tell clients who have unused credits.
Renewals in the next 30 days appear in the Next 30 days view.
Set status to Paused or Cancelled and note the reason.
Run this once a week, always on the same day.
Update On hand for anything used
Look at Stock check for items marked Reorder
Move short-dated items to the front
Retire anything past its best-before date
Send one order per supplier and note the date.
Offer the next appointment before the client leaves.
Mention the membership if they have booked three or more visits.
Send a short personal message offering a free add-on.
After two tries, leave the client Lapsed and move on.
